_note: Verses where the NT NAMES a typological link, by the word it uses AND by reading. Ground truth for cross-testament linking: the text's own claim, not an inference. 30 verses carry a marker word; these 12 survived verification. See tools/declaredtypes.py for the 18 rejected and why.

reason: the events happened as types for us
text: These things took place as examples to keep us from craving evil things as they did.

reason: baptism is named the antitype (ἀντίτυπον) of the flood's water: 'this water symbolizes the baptism that now saves you'
text: And this water symbolizes the baptism that now saves you also-not the removal of dirt from the body, but the pledge of a clear conscience toward God-through the resurrection of Jesus Christ,

reason: made an example of what is coming on the ungodly -- judgement typology
text: if He condemned the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah to destruction, reducing them to ashes as an example of what is coming on the ungodly;

reason: the tabernacle built to the pattern Moses was shown -- the heavenly-original sense, Heb 8:5's source
text: Our fathers had the tabernacle of the Testimony with them in the wilderness. It was constructed exactly as God had directed Moses, according to the pattern he had seen.

reason: a shadow of what was coming; the body is Christ
text: These are a shadow of the things to come, but the body that casts it belongs to Christ.

reason: named as allegory: the two covenants
text: These things serve as illustrations, for the women represent two covenants. One covenant is from Mount Sinai and bears children into slavery: This is Hagar.

reason: a shadow of the good things to come
text: For the law is only a shadow of the good things to come, not the realities themselves. It can never, by the same sacrifices offered year after year, make perfect those who draw near to worship.

reason: their disobedience is the example not to follow
text: Let us, therefore, make every effort to enter that rest, so that no one will fall by following the same pattern of disobedience.

reason: a copy and shadow of the heavenly
text: The place where they serve is a copy and shadow of what is in heaven. This is why Moses was warned when he was about to build the tabernacle: “See to it that you make everything according to the pattern shown you on the mountain.”
So it was necessary for the copies of the heavenly things to be purified with these sacrifices, but the heavenly things themselves with better sacrifices than these.

reason: a man-made antitype of the true one
text: For Christ did not enter a man-made copy of the true sanctuary, but He entered heaven itself, now to appear on our behalf in the presence of God.

reason: Adam is 'a pattern of the One to come' -- the text's own word, τύπος
text: Nevertheless, death reigned from Adam until Moses, even over those who did not sin in the way that Adam transgressed. He is a pattern of the One to come.
